entries.summary_en: Deconvolves spatial expression without an external single-cell reference.

entries.name: steinbock
entries.summary_en: Processes multichannel images through segmentation, quantification and related steps.

entries.name: steinbock + imcRtools + cytomapper
entries.summary_en: Connects steinbock, imcRtools and cytomapper in a linked software workflow.

entries.name: steinbock quantification
entries.summary_en: Quantifies cell-level signals within steinbock.

entries.name: stereoscope
entries.summary_en: Jointly models a single-cell reference and spatial expression data.

entries.name: STitch3D
entries.summary_en: Integrates multiple sections for 3D spatial analysis.

entries.name: stLearn
entries.summary_en: Candidate entry; its scope and primary sources are awaiting review.

entries.name: stLearn spatial communication
entries.summary_en: Provides spatial communication analysis within stLearn.

entries.name: STProtein
entries.summary_en: A candidate spatial protein prediction method identified through a preprint; journal publication status awaits review.

entries.name: Tangram
entries.summary_en: Maps single-cell expression onto spatial data; its output is not simply a cell-type proportion estimate.

entries.name: THItoGene
entries.summary_en: Predicts spatial transcriptomics from histology images.

entries.name: TITAN
entries.summary_en: Learns multimodal whole-slide representations beyond individual patch embeddings.

entries.name: totalVI
entries.summary_en: Jointly models RNA and protein and predicts missing proteins under appropriate training or reference conditions.

entries.name: TRIDENT
entries.summary_en: Candidate entry; its scope and primary sources are awaiting review.

entries.name: UCE
entries.summary_en: Learns general-purpose cell representations for zero-shot embedding.

entries.name: UCell
entries.summary_en: Scores gene-set activity; spatial structure is not modeled by default.

entries.name: UNI
entries.summary_en: Provides general-purpose pathology image representations; checkpoints and publications are tracked separately.

entries.name: UNI2-h

entries.summary_en: Extracts frozen pathology image features for ROI and slide analysis, with task adaptation also supported. Weights and licenses are tracked separately from UNI.

entries.name: UTAG
entries.summary_en: Performs unsupervised analysis of tissue organization; detailed inputs and outputs await verification.

entries.name: VALIS
entries.summary_en: Registers histology and microscopy images.

entries.name: VALIS outputs
entries.summary_en: Supports inspection of registration outputs; specific interactive capabilities await review.

entries.name: Virchow
entries.summary_en: Provides pathology image representations; versions have separate metadata.

entries.name: Virchow2
entries.summary_en: Provides pathology image representations; versions have separate metadata.

entries.name: Vitessce
entries.summary_en: Provides linked, multiview visualization of omics data.

entries.name: Voyager
entries.summary_en: Provides exploratory spatial statistics using spatial geometries and SpatialFeatureExperiment.

entries.name: Xenium Explorer
entries.summary_en: Provides platform-specific exploration of Xenium data through vendor software.
